components.description: Shared default field: 32px high, 16px text on mobile and 14px text from 768px at default density.
components.css: .ds-input{height:calc(var(--spacing,.25rem)*8);min-width:0;padding:calc(var(--spacing,.25rem)*1) calc(var(--spacing,.25rem)*2.5);background:transparent;color:var(--foreground);border:1px solid var(--input);border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:16px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5rem;caret-color:var(--primary);outline:none;transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms,border-color 150ms}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground);opacity:1}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring) 50%,transparent)}.ds-input:disabled{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--input) 50%,transparent);pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}.ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--destructive);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 20%,transparent)}:host-context(.dark) .ds-input{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--input) 30%,transparent)}@media(min-width:768px){.ds-input{font-size:var(--text-sm,.875rem);line-height:1.25rem}}

narrative.northStar: The clarity of a document, the capability of an AI gateway.
narrative.overview:
The user pinned Notion's public website as the reference. The implemented New API interface uses white space, black typography, blue primary actions and restrained pastel surfaces. Authenticated pages use a quiet document workspace with a warm gray sidebar.

The default theme shares this foundation across public pages and operational tools. Dark mode and explicit user theme, font, radius, density and content-layout preferences remain supported. The tokens above describe the default light theme and density; component overrides and user preferences can change their rendered values.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Reuse shared semantic variables so dark mode and saved theme preferences carry through new surfaces.

dos: Do use the shared tokens, a clear heading hierarchy, readable gray text and visible focus states.
Do preserve translations, navigation destinations, loading/error states and legal attribution.
Do label homepage example data as Preview.
Do keep New API / QuantumNous branding and existing user theme preferences.
donts: Don't present this product as Notion.
Don't add arbitrary saturated backgrounds, oversized pills or decorative gradients to the default document language.
Don't invent customer or performance metrics.
